variables: ordered mode IDs/names/parent IDs/raw values; aliases represented by target variable IDs
styles: properties including variable alias target IDs

policy.numbers: Finite numbers use decimal form rounded to at most 12 fractional places with trailing zeroes removed; negative zero is 0.
policy.identityAndSorting: Identity and primary sort use key, falling back to id only when key is absent; id and key remain fingerprint values.
policy.arrays: Collection modes retain Figma order; scopes and top-level variable/style state records are sorted lexicographically; all other arrays retain semantic source order.

contentHashPolicy.serialization: The same canonical serializer as fingerprint.policy.

naming.input: Full slash-delimited variable name plus its collection family/name.
transformations: Drop one leading segment when its normalized value is core.
After normalization, drop a leading variable path segment when it equals the normalized collection family/name.
Collapse an immediately preceding normalized segment when the next segment is identical or begins with the preceding segment plus a hyphen.
naming.manualPrecedence: A non-empty variable.codeSyntax value is emitted unchanged with source manual; otherwise the derived value is emitted.

units.statement: Figma stores numeric values, not responsive CSS or platform units. storedUnit/sourceUnit describe the raw design value; buildUnit is a recommendation.
rules: Opacity and explicit percentage semantics infer one scale from every concrete terminal value in their collection/group cohort.
Every classified FLOAT mode emits a deterministic build cell; unresolved cells fabricate no value.
Effect blur radii remain px and integral grid column counts remain unitless.
Aliases inherit terminal variable type, scopes, name, collection, and cohort semantics.
Font size and dimensions use rem at a 16px root; contextual pixel line height and letter spacing use unitless and em ratios.

Breakpoints remain px in unitHint. Device dimensions that are viewport fractions carry a viewport-width or viewport-height responsive rule; consumers emit vw/dvh. Fractions are derived from value ÷ designer-designated reference variable, not from names.

expressions.statement: Supported variable expressions are resolved into developer-ready build cells while the raw expression remains auditable.

COMPOSE_COLOR.css: Relative CSS color syntax retaining both variable references.
COMPOSE_COLOR.literal: Eight-digit hexadecimal fallback resolved for the active mode.

typeRamp.statement: Text styles preserve exact Figma values and variable binding provenance while exposing contextual developer-ready fontSize, lineHeight, and letterSpacing values.

mode.ordering: Preserve Figma collection mode order and IDs exactly.
mode.layoutCollection: For the local collection named layout, sm/md/lg/xl and their flush/sidebar-main variants are responsive layout variants, never themes. Widths come from the file device/width variable in the corresponding mode.
mode.dynamicWidths: Read numeric device/width values dynamically. If unavailable, retain the explicit semantic family and an unresolved null width rather than a stale hardcoded breakpoint.
mode.colorCollection: Every mode in the local color collection is a theme. Theme identity is the normalized mode name, including light, dark, and bttf.
mode.genericCollections: Other collections only parse explicit numeric widths and whole-word mobile/tablet/desktop/wide families; unknown values remain null and no theme is invented.

responsive.statement: Figma mode values remain source samples. Viewport fractions are derived from value ÷ designer-designated reference variable; only variables in a reference-variable group or with a screen-percentage description are eligible. Fractions snap to the nearest whole percent within 0.005; endpoint clamps are recommendations only when every sample fits.
